mechanism_narrative: A sudden increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.25% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real GDP over two consecutive quarters indicates strong economic growth, which boosts corporate earnings and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where GDPC1 increased over two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage costs and reduces corporate profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 1% in a month signals increased economic activity and corporate output, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in retail and food services sales by more than 2% in a month signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where RSAFS decreased by more than 2% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 in a month signals strong job growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts increase by more than 10% and CPI increases by more than 0.3% in a month, it signals strong demand and inflationary pressures, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate increased corporate revenues.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases > 10% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where both HOUST increased by more than 10% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.3% in a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate is below 1% and the CPI increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it signals an environment of low borrowing costs coupled with rising inflation, which can lead to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors seek higher returns in equities.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary regime with low interest rates
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS was below 1% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% in a month.
